_comment: Default model profiles used as a fallback when an admin has not set meta.profile on a model. Rules are matched against the model id (and name) top-to-bottom; LATER matches override EARLIER ones field-by-field, so keep broad patterns first and more specific patterns below. A `match` of '*' matches everything; otherwise it is a case-insensitive substring match, or a glob when it contains '*' (anchored ^...$). Axes (speed/quality) are 1-3. `eco` shows the green leaf badge (only on the genuinely efficient small-active-param models). Hosting/datacenter is intentionally NOT baked here — it comes from the per-deployment MODEL_HOSTING env (see hostingFromDeployment in profile.ts), because the same model id can live in a different datacenter for a different client; an admin meta.profile.hosting override still wins when set. There is intentionally NO catch-all '*' default — a model matching no rule (and with no admin meta.profile override) resolves to an empty profile and renders with no decoration (just its name, no meters), so custom/workspace models and not-yet-profiled models look unchanged from upstream. This first entry is comment-only (no `profile`) and is skipped by the resolver.
